purpose: Analyze passenger demographics, geographic distribution, flight status, airport activity, time patterns, and categorical relationships.

insights.title: Flight status
insights.text: Cancelled is the most frequent flight status, with 32,942 of 98,619 records (33.4%).

insights.title: Nationality
insights.text: China is the most frequently represented nationality, with 18,317 records.

insights.title: Airport activity
insights.text: San Pedro Airport is the most frequently represented departure airport, with 43 records.

insights.title: Time pattern
insights.text: August has the highest monthly departure count (8,544), while Sunday is the busiest weekday category (14,289).

insights.title: Geographic distribution
insights.text: North America contains the largest number of records (32,033) among the represented continents.

insights.title: Travel classification
insights.text: The approximate nationality-vs-airport-country classification contains 96,844 International and 1,775 Domestic records.

limitations: The source dataset represents records in a single dataset period rather than a live airline operation.
Domestic/International is an approximate classification because it compares nationality with airport country; it is not a ticket itinerary field.
The dashboard presents associations and descriptive patterns; it does not infer causal relationships.
